name: Bridge Metrics Phase Declaration
purpose: Declare a metrics-only phase for evaluating trace quality and projection safety without permitting theorem or physics escalation.

phase_definition.canonical_statement: The bridge metrics phase permits the definition and use of metrics for evaluating projection trace quality, loss clarity, conflict preservation, and projection safety as non-physical analog indicators only.
phase_definition.non_escalation_rule: No bridge metric may be interpreted as proof, physical evidence, or source identity.

governance_rules.rule: Bridge metrics evaluate trace quality, not source truth.
Metrics must maintain NON_PHYSICAL and ANALOG_ONLY status.
No trace score may be treated as source identity or full recoverability.
Conflict preservation is a mandatory metric requirement.
Loss clarity metrics must prevent false complementarity claims.
Any attempt to promote a theorem based on metric scores must fail validation.

forbidden_claims: High trace quality proves physical reality.
Trace completeness implies full source reconstruction.
